climate.method: Extract published numeric facts. Missing or annotated cells stay null; no inferred replacement. 30-year composite values, not current weather or national averages.

waters.method: Natural Earth source vertices remain unchanged for all rivers except St. Lawrence, whose original 7-vertex upstream reach is retained in the source archive and whose display uses the unchanged official CGNDB geographical-feature footprint. Cross-border waters retained; no river-flow or basin-area calculation.

replacementSources.publisher: Natural Resources Canada / Geographical Names Board of Canada
replacementSources.title: CGNDB St. Lawrence River official geographical feature
replacementSources.sourceMetadataNote: Relevance and accuracy are held raw API fields; no cartographic scale or accuracy-unit claim is inferred.
replacementSources.method: Replace only the St. Lawrence feature with the exact official geographical-feature MultiPolygon. No clipping, simplification, joining, inferred river centerline or invented downstream coordinates. Display the footprint outline; this is not a wetted-area, navigation-channel, bathymetry or flow-quantity dataset. The original metadata bbox is broader than the geometry bounds; both are recorded independently.

waters.method: Keep features having a source vertex in Canada display bounds; coordinates unchanged. Includes cross-border waters; not a national clipping or discharge map.

physiography.title: Atlas of Canada 6th Edition: Physiographic Regions
physiography.method: Official historical map, unchanged layout; JPEG resized for display. Its Lambert projection is not overlaid onto the separate locator map.
